propositions: Before b690, Pass-1 finder silently ran on sonnet despite declaring trivial/haiku in the model_ladder, because PydanticAIRunner.run discarded req.config and used the runner's inherited verifier cfg
After b690 lands, the Pass-1 finder will run on haiku (trivial) as declared in plan-review.yaml, weakening the gate that generates blocking findings from opus capability to haiku capability
The regression is undetectable by offline tests because they substitute FunctionModel/FakeRunner and do not exercise the actual model selection at the ProductionBatchRunner→run_pass1→pass1_chunk seam
Sidecar records only the verifier's model (sonnet), never Pass-1's actual model, so the downgrade is invisible in artifacts and produces no alarm despite reducing review strength

Before 2026-06-27, plan-review Pass-1 generated 115 findings on opus; after _verifier_cfg landed on 2026-06-27, recordings show zero opus runs and 2,710+ sonnet runs—a total changeover indicating unintended regression rather than design choice
The prerequisite finder's bin packing now targets haiku's 200k window instead of sonnet's 1M window, triggering spurious context-limit escalation and token waste
